# Krishna Zolpatil

> Krishna Zolpatil (Krishna Zol, @krishnazolpatil) is an AI-native Senior Product Designer at Uniblox, based in India. Before that, Krishna spent four years at Naya Studio, shipping 200+ features on a platform that won an iF Design Award in 2024.

I designed the AI inside two products. A workflow platform that generates from what a project already holds, with no prompt box. An estimator that files every number with its source. Teams at Google and MillerKnoll run on the platform.

## Facts
- 200+ features shipped in four years at Naya
- 30 features designed in two months, 20 already released
- ~50% less design time, prototyping in code with Claude
- 70+ NPS on the product, held for two years
- Now at: Uniblox, AI-powered insurance infrastructure
- Strong in: Agentic UX, human-AI interaction, zero to one, design systems, B2B SaaS
- Works in: Figma, Claude Code, React, GitHub, Vercel
- Started in: Computer science, then graphic design
- Based in: India, remote worldwide

## Recognition
- iF Design Award (Product UX, 2024): The platform I joined at its foundations won an iF Design Award for Product UX.
- MillerKnoll (Estimation AI): Close to 70% of the team's time saved, by their VP of Product's count.
- USC (Workflow platform): One class became 1,500 licences. A director there called it a design journal.
- Autodesk (Project memory): I designed the AI feature and the film that explained it. The film ran on Autodesk's page.
- RISD (Review panel): Invited to sit alongside RISD professors and critique the next generation of designers.

## Work
- [Naya Workflow Platform](https://krishnazolpatil.com/work/naya-workflow/): A workspace where AI generates from everything a product team already has. Used by teams at Google and MillerKnoll.
- [Estimation AI](https://krishnazolpatil.com/work/estimation-ai/): Upload a product photo, get a costed estimate in minutes, with the plan and every source in view.
- [Group Sharing](https://krishnazolpatil.com/work/sharing/): Share the folder, not the file.
- [Yoink](https://krishnazolpatil.com/work/yoink/): Copy any website into Figma as editable layers. Designed, coded and shipped alone, on the Chrome Web Store.
- [Email Signature Generator](https://krishnazolpatil.com/work/email-signature-generator/): Replaced a three-week, three-person manual process.
- [QR Code Builder](https://krishnazolpatil.com/work/qr-code-builder/): On-brand QR codes, self-serve for the whole company.
